name: session-style
description: Gives every session in a project the same prompt color and name prefix, from .claude/session-style.json or your defaults

color.title: Default color
color.description: The prompt bar color (/color) for projects whose .claude/session-style.json sets none; "none" leaves it alone.

namePrefix.title: Default name prefix
namePrefix.description: Put before every session name (/rename) in projects whose .claude/session-style.json sets none; empty for no prefix.
